title: Cost center pool to paid overage
summary: Enable a cost center AI credit pool and show excess usage rolling into metered budgets when overage is allowed.

steps.title: Open the month with a first draw
steps.description: A week into the billing period Alice consumes 1,200 of the 3,900 credits included for the AI Innovation cost center.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost center included pool and paid overage remains $0.

steps.title: Continue drawing down the pool
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost center included pool, leaving 1,800 credits.

steps.title: Pass the halfway mark
steps.description: A further 1,000 included credits are consumed.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost center included pool, leaving 800 credits.

steps.title: Use the cost center pool
steps.description: The final 800 included credits available to the AI Innovation cost center are consumed.
steps.expected: The cost center included pool reaches 100%, while paid overage remains $0.

steps.title: Roll into paid overage
steps.description: Alice consumes 2,400 more AI credits after the cost center included pool is exhausted.
steps.expected: $24 of paid overage is attributed to the cost-center and enterprise metered budgets, and the cost-center budget crosses its 75% threshold.
